tooltip.tarot.fool.active: Chaotic gust: air dash, disorients nearby foes, no fall damage for 4 s.
tooltip.tarot.magician.active: Prismatic beam that hits and chains to 2 nearby foes.
tooltip.tarot.priestess.active: Revelation pulse: outlines creatures and flags nearby chests.
tooltip.tarot.priestess.passive: A flash reveals nearby chests every 15 s.
tooltip.tarot.empress.active: 8 s grove: crops grow and allies heal inside the circle.
tooltip.tarot.emperor.active: Decree: repels enemies and grants absorption per enemy.
tooltip.tarot.hierophant.active: Consecration: repairs your gear and grants experience.
tooltip.tarot.lovers.active: Bond: heals allies and pets within 10 blocks.
tooltip.tarot.chariot.active: Charge that tramples and knocks back foes in a line.
tooltip.tarot.strength.active: Leap and Slam: seismic shockwave that damages and pushes.
tooltip.tarot.hermit.active: 8 s shadow cloak: invisible, mobs lose your trail.
tooltip.tarot.hermit.passive: Hidden from mobs while sneaking still.
tooltip.tarot.wheel.active: Roulette: 5 possible outcomes, from loot to a mild curse.
tooltip.tarot.wheel.passive: Fatal blow: a roulette decides if you live (40/50/60%). 3 min cooldown.
tooltip.tarot.justice.active: 6 s scales: reflect 50% of damage back at attackers.
tooltip.tarot.hanged.active: Inversion: lifts enemies 3 s then drops them.
tooltip.tarot.death.active: Reaper's Mark 8 s: on death it bursts into souls and heals you 3 hearts.
tooltip.tarot.temperance.active: Alchemy: purges harmful effects, converts them into boons.
tooltip.tarot.devil.active: 12 s pact: pay 3 hearts, bonus damage and lifesteal; then weakness.
tooltip.tarot.tower.active: Marks the ground 1.5 s then a concentrated bolt strikes (no fire).
tooltip.tarot.star.active: 8 s constellation: zone that heals and cleanses allies.
tooltip.tarot.moon.active: Lunar tide: low gravity, outlines distant enemies.
tooltip.tarot.moon.passive: Night vision at night; blindness immunity.
tooltip.tarot.sun.active: 10 s aura: burns undead, purifies poison/wither, recharges.
tooltip.tarot.judgement.active: Pillars of light: marks 5 foes and smites them after 1.2 s.
tooltip.tarot.world.active: 4 s dome of 6 blocks: mobs and projectiles at 10% speed.
